case: ESRF Example #3 hybrid undulator, HCurl order-1 reduced-A first Picard matrix with Kelvin exterior
meshes: Cubit 2025.12 build_hybrid_undulator_mesh.py; iron/air/kelvin sizes 4/6/12 mm times mesh_size_scale
finding: SparseCholesky factors while the L-factor NZE stays below 2^31 (1.66e9 at 597k free DOF) and fails beyond it: bad_array_new_length at 951k free DOF (extrapolated NZE ~3.6e9) and an access violation at 1.72M free DOF (~9.9e9). The matrix itself is factorizable: a diagnostic PARDISO run of the full system was still factoring at 71 GB peak when stopped; PARDISO is not a fallback.
consequence: the full-size reduced-A route uses the explicit solver='ams' (AMS-preconditioned CG with a true-residual check)
